name: io.github.apurvsinghgautam/robin
title: Robin: AI-Powered Dark Web OSINT
description: Dark web OSINT over Tor: search onion engines, scrape pages, report with your own model.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open. The stdio transport is a JSON-RPC conversation on the container's stdin and stdout.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the host disconnects. Robin keeps nothing in the container itself; saved investigations live in the volume below.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Keep saved investigations in the named Docker volume robin-investigations, so they survive --rm and any Robin container that mounts the same volume, the Streamlit UI included, sees them.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server. With no command the same image serves the Streamlit UI on 8501 instead.
